messages.subject: Additive effect from CIM & MQM
parts:
Hi Karl, Hello all:

After searching through older posts, I get that I can obtain the effect estimates using makeqtl followed by fitqtl. But is there a way, say a formula or a function that I can use, to get the additive allelic effect of the QTL directly from CIM analysis? And from MQM?
Thanks.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Additive effect from CIM & MQM
parts:
Unfortunately, there's no way to get the QTL effects from cim(), nor (I think) MQM.

karl
